sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-01 and 2016-12-01, customer C07987 card(s) C07987-K2, C06224-K2, C01983-K1 experienced unauthorized transactions totaling $243.83 conducted via the online channel. The activity matches the card_not_present_new_device fraud typology, displaying abnormal volume and velocity inconsistent with historical cardholder profile. Device/region cluster shared across 4 cards, connected to 43 prior confirmed fraud cases. Customer verification confirmed unauthorized use. The compromised card has been blocked and scheduled for reissue, and linked entities have been placed under protective monitoring.
